title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.33183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As AI systems become increasingly capable of executing and evaluating experiments, ideation is emerging as a bottleneck in automated scientific and engineering iteration. In many real-world domains, useful ideas are sparse and their validation is costly, making direct online exploration inefficient. We observe that repository evolution provides a scalable source of reusable technical experience: code changes record concrete technical hypotheses, while subsequent revisions, adoption, and reuse provide signals about their utility. Based on this observation, we propose REI, a Repository Evolution-driven Ideation framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution, injecting domain-specific technical experience into model parameters and reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error. translated_title: REI：从仓库演化中学习创意构思
translated_abstract: 随着AI系统在执行和评估实验方面的能力日益增强，创意构思正成为自动化科学与工程迭代中的瓶颈。在许多现实世界领域中，有用的想法稀少且验证成本高昂，这使得直接的在线探索效率低下。我们观察到，仓库的演化过程提供了一种可扩展的可复用技术经验来源：代码变更记录了具体的技术假设，而后续的修订、采纳和复用则提供了关于这些假设实用性的信号。基于这一观察，我们提出了REI，一个由仓库演化驱动的创意构思框架，它从仓库演化中学习可复用的创意策略，将领域特定的技术经验注入模型参数，从而减少对昂贵试错的依赖。我们进一步发现了质量驱动的创意优化中一个隐藏的失效模式：语义多样性坍塌。尽管生成的想法
tldr: 本文提出REI框架，通过从代码仓库的演化历史中学习可复用的创意策略，将领域技术经验注入模型参数，以解决AI自动化科学迭代中创意构思的瓶颈，并首次揭示了质量驱动优化中的语义多样性坍塌问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes REI, a framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution to inject domain-specific technical experience into model parameters, addressing the ideation bottleneck in AI-driven scientific iteration, and reveals semantic diversity collapse as a hidden failure mode in quality-driven optimization.
